t: High performance, high quality bits designed for the professional user. Includes a variety of screwdriver bits, drill bits and general tools and can be used with wood, metal, plastic, brick and concrete block. Compatible with most major power tool brands. Supplied in a heavy duty carry case.
b: Contents: 9 Metal Bits, 3 Masonry Bits, 5 Brad Bits, 21 Driver Bits, Magnetic Bit Holder, Drill Diameter Gauge & Carry Case.
Suitable For Use with 3-Jaw Chuck Machines on Rotary & Impact Modes
Suitable for Masonry, Plastic, Metal & Wood
